children: The scheduled KAITO supply unlock in August 2027 releases up to 32.6 million tokens, equal to 13.51% of the circulating supply. The release covers allocations for the community, the ecosystem, the foundation, investors, liquidity and the team.

The release adds tokens to circulation and gives recipients the option to sell tokens that were previously locked. If recipients sell, that can put downward pressure on the price as the market adjusts to the larger supply.

title: KAITO: Up to 32.6 million tokens unlock - Aug 2027
